label: PPP approved amount
description: Current approval amount for SBA Paycheck Protection Program loans approved from April 3, 2020 through July 19, 2021

source.label: U.S. Small Business Administration PPP FOIA data

caveat: Owner demographic fields are borrower-reported and frequently unanswered. Approved amount is not the same as forgiveness; forgiveness is shown separately. County attribution uses the project county, with Census ZIP relationships as a fallback.
